data.name: Holy Valkyrie ExS-TIA 3
data.detailed_description:
GAMEPLAY & FEATURES

  • Single-ending visual novel with 30 minutes till credits

    STORY

    Peace returns after the reborn Jineivra is defeated.
    Back from her trip, Leese returns to her own world to see how things are going.
    But in the meantime, monsters soon begin to emerge again.
    Marina Katsuragi transforms into ExS-TIA once again to defeat them.
    How will ExS-TIA fight against this new, formidable threat? The curtain on the battlefield rises once more.

    CHARACTER


    Marina Katsuragi
    The main heroine of the first game, and the protagonist Souma's lover.
    Possesses high PP and transforms into ExS-TIA to battle against interdimensional invaders.
    Kind-hearted, but steadfast in her willingness to fight for others.

    Leese
    A knight from another dimension. Level-headed and stout-hearted.
    Possesses a high amount of magical power, and fights alongside Marina.
    In this game, she has initially returned to her own world to see how things are going.

    Azarin
    The daughter of the invading Emperor. Though having fought against ExS-TIA before, she has since defected for various reasons.
    She is somewhat unpredictable but has adapted to living in modern society.

    Yuri Amakubo
    The scientist who developed the ExS-TIA system.
    Characterized by her extreme imperturbability and monotone voice.
    Normally provides logistical support.
